item.title: Tranmere Rovers 0-2 Salford City: Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Tranmere Rovers 0-2 Salford City In the seventh minute, Kristian Dennis volleyed the ball to Dylan Jones, who fired towards the left corner, but was denied by a good save. Nine minutes before half-time, Ryan Graydon latched onto the end of a lofted ball, but his header landed on the roof of the net. Close. item.title: Lewis Warrington joins Rovers on a two-and-a-half year deal
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are delighted to announce the signing of Lewis Warrington on a two-and-a-half year contract. Warrington, 23, was on loan at Rovers from Everton for the second half of the 2021/22 season and made 17 appearances. He began his career at Everton from where he joined Fleetwood Town and Plymouth Argyle on loan after Rovers. item.title: Zech Obiero joins Tranmere Rovers on loan until the end of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are delighted to announce that midfielder Zech Obiero has joined on loan from League One Leyton Orient until the end of the season. Obiero, 21, began his youth career at Premier League Tottenham Hotspur before joining Leyton Orient at the age of 14. He has spent time on loan at non-League Cheshunt and Chelmsford City and has made 40 appearances for the O’s. Speaking after joining, Zech said: "I’m really happy to be here, excited to start a new journey and just ready to get going.

item.title: West Didsbury & Chorlton Women 3 Tranmere Rovers Women 2 : Match Report
item.description: Rovers suffered defeat in a five-goal thriller at the Step Places Stadium. Tranmere found themselves behind inside two minutes when Naomi Lawrence directed an Ava Bushell cross into the far corner of Beth Marshall’s goal. Rovers would go close to an equaliser following a corner in the 10th minute when a shot from Ash Bullock on the edge of the box hit the underside of the bar before Lorna Stratton’s looping header was somehow hooked off the goal line. item.title: Richie Smallwood joins Bristol Rovers on loan until the end of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers can confirm Richie Smallwood has joined Bristol Rovers on loan until the end of the season. Smallwood, 35, has made 32 appearances this season in the league, FA Cup, Carabao Cup and Vertu Trophy. The Club would like to thank Richie for his contribution and wish him all the best at Bristol Rovers.

item.title: Max Dickov joins Tranmere Rovers from Mansfield Town on loan until the end of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are delighted to announce that forward Max Dickov has joined from League One Mansfield Town on loan until the end of the season. Dickov came through the academies of Manchester City and Oldham Athletic and started his senior career at non-League clubs AFC Macclesfield, Poynton and Stockport Town. item.title: Stephan Negru has joined Tranmere Rovers from Oxford United on loan until the end of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are delighted to announce that defender Stephan Negru has joined on loan from Championship club Oxford United until the end of the season. Negru, 23, started his career in Ireland with Shelbourne and joined Oxford United in January 2023.
